reconciler.detail: Tick runs production local scheduling and context logic, but all external observation, authority guard, replacement and request dependencies are fakes/recorders. Default decision logging/correlation is incidental and unasserted. No real authority/NATS/OCI/ledger service or replacement process is reached.

cancellation.detail: The blocking replacer only exchanges local channels and waits for context cancellation. A real timer/goroutine is local concurrency, not a process boundary.

file_evidence.detail: Production Evidence opens actual slot files using O_NOFOLLOW, checks Fstat ownership/type/size/permissions, reads bytes and decodes their candidate structure. Malformed/misplaced wire is ignored and deduplicated by content. Signature authorization is explicitly absent: decoding only routes and Ledger.AdvanceSlot is not reached. Signing in the fixture constructs input only, and no crypto ran during this review.

refound.detail: Real production pending-file writes/rename/sync/readback/permission checks, health-file write/read and flock are exercised by source assertions. Ledger and health content are fabricated inputs; there is no real peer quorum, host restart, controller process or cloud launch. Admit has an independent local ledger guard before readPending at lines76–82.

qualification_limits: Runtime UNKNOWN_NO_RECEIPTS_REVIEWED_NO_EXECUTION; no tests, builds, crypto, locks, signing or project helpers were executed.
File scenarios only establish source-visible local reads/writes/permissions/no-follow/removal; no crash or power-loss durability is qualified.
No live NATS/authority lease/OCI/retirement ledger/root trust verification or replacement launch is reached by these assertions. All external reconciler dependencies are fakes.
Refound restart means a new Go guard value reusing paths in the same process; lock test uses two descriptors in one process and does not prove cross-process behavior.
Refound one-slot root has an independent local-only ledger block; recovery invalid-input error is coupled to actual unchanged persisted identity readback, with that limit retained.

All original assertions, negative/trust/fencing/no-repeat and preservation obligations remain retained; no repository/ledger/count mutation, promotion, deletion, retirement or global completion credit.
